surfaceEvidence: Project recovery proposal review is exposed as a distinct review region.
The surface states that preview and approval persist proposal history locally while approval does not invoke project-store execution.
Separate apply controls are exposed for migration, create, rename, save, save-as, handout, audio, token, and background operations.
The surface reports no persisted project active and no project session open, so no project-content mutation was available or performed.

decision.reason: M597 confirms the packaged desktop review surface visibly exposes local-project review, explicit approval, operation-specific apply boundaries, and no-generic-executor/no-write messaging against the exact M596 artifact set. The local Windows UI helper could not provide a screenshot refresh or close action, so this is bounded packaged evidence with an automation blocker, not aggregate Stage 11 acceptance.
